shortDescription: Wait for a VELOS chassis partition to match a condition before continuing

options.name: delay
options.description: Number of seconds to wait before starting to poll.

options.name: msg
options.description: This overrides the normal error message from a failure to meet the required conditions.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks.

options.name: state
options.description: The condition for which the system is waiting. Defaults to C(running), which verifies the specified chassis partition has been created with a status of 'running'. C(ssh-ready) waits for a deployed tenant to be reachable via SSH.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the desired state.
